font.reason: Geometric, techy Kufi closest in mood to Avenir/Futura; variable font so real bold; works with background-clip:text and heavy blur glow layers.

comps.translatedSummary: Line 1: «فوق‌شارژ در عملکرد» (keyword «فوق‌شارژ» gets the gradient charge); line 2: «با اطمینانی استوار».

rtlDecisions.why: Keyword is the first word of line 1, so it is the right-most word; the charge wave runs from word start (right) to end (left) like reading.
inset(-25% 0 -25% (100-p)%) so the reveal grows from the right edge.

rtlDecisions.what: Soft glow masks, trail mask, head hot-core clip
rtlDecisions.why: 90deg -> 270deg gradients and swapped inset sides, same percentages measured from the right.
Blue (start) stays at the word start (right), amber tail on the left.
Anchored at the word's right edge, scale(-0.74,1) flip+fit to the narrower Persian word; seeded bolt pattern and timing unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: translateY entrance, centered composition, symmetric ambient radial glow, seeds, easing, glow opacities
rtlDecisions.why: Vertical/gravity and symmetric elements carry no reading direction.
Persian letters join; synthetic italic breaks joins; taller ascenders/dots; smaller x-height.
All glow layers duplicate the same joined word so shaping stays intact.

rtlDecisions.what: Temporary frame offset (useCurrentFrame()+40) left by interrupted attempt
rtlDecisions.why: Removed; timeline is the original (fill 12-30f, lightning from 33f). Late beats inspected with --duration 100 because registry length is 20f.

concerns: Faint rectangular edge of blurred glow layers during the sweep is also present in the original; kept for fidelity.
Registry duration is only 20f, so video shows only the sweep start unless --duration is passed; design length is ~100f (fill 18f + 1-3s steady).
